dialogues.jp:
満開の桜が咲き乱れている――まぁ、この島で
は桜が１年中不必要なぐらい咲いているのだが。
dialogues.en:
The cherry blossoms are in full bloom... On this island, you
can see the cherry blossoms all year around.
dialogues.text:
The cherry blossoms are in full bloom... On this island, you
can see the cherry blossoms all year around.

dialogues.jp:
景色は変わらないのに、逆にこの島では、人が
移り変わる。
dialogues.en:
The scenery is the same, but people are always changing on
this island.
dialogues.text:
The scenery is the same, but people are always changing on
this island.

dialogues.jp: 返事はない、ただの屍のようだ……。
dialogues.en: No response. It's like I'm talking to a dead person.
dialogues.text: No response. It's like I'm talking to a dead person.

dialogues.jp: 最近になって遊んだゲームを思い出す。
dialogues.en: I remember the game we used to play.
dialogues.text: I remember the game we used to play.

dialogues.jp: 誰もいないはずの家に呼びかける。
dialogues.en: I call in where nobody lives.
dialogues.text: I call in where nobody lives.

dialogues.jp:
いなくなってから相手の大切さに気づくなんて、
またバカなことをやってしまった。
dialogues.en:
I was a fool to only realize how important she was after she
had gone.
dialogues.text:
I was a fool to only realize how important she was after she
had gone.

dialogues.jp: ばあちゃんがいなくなって。
音夢の両親がいなくなって。
さくらまで居なくなってしまった。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「早く行かないと遅刻するよ〜」
dialogues.en: "You're going to be late if you don't get going."
dialogues.text: "You're going to be late if you don't get going."

dialogues.jp:
答えながら、俺はじっとさくらの家を見つめ続
けた。
dialogues.en: I keep looking at Sakura's house as I respond to Nemu.
dialogues.text: I keep looking at Sakura's house as I respond to Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 急に腕をひかれてバランスをくずす。
dialogues.en: She pulls my arm, making me lose my balance.
dialogues.text: She pulls my arm, making me lose my balance.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いつまで居なくなった人のこと考えてるの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you still thinking about the girl who's gone?"
dialogues.text: "Are you still thinking about the girl who's gone?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、別に、そんな深く考えてるわけじゃな
　いけどさ……」
dialogues.en: "No, I'm not really thinking about her, but..."
dialogues.text: "No, I'm not really thinking about her, but..."

dialogues.jp: 「……もぅ、誰もいなくなって欲しくないな」
dialogues.en: "I don't want anyone else to leave me."
dialogues.text: "I don't want anyone else to leave me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いなくなる人もいるけど、新しく出会う人も
　いるからさ」
dialogues.en: "Some people have left, but you'll meet new people as well."
dialogues.text: "Some people have left, but you'll meet new people as well."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「みんなの分まで私が一緒にいるよ！」
dialogues.en: "No matter how many people leave you, I'll be here for you!"
dialogues.text: "No matter how many people leave you, I'll be here for you!"

dialogues.jp:
音夢にずるずる引きずられながら、それでも俺
は何度も振り返ってしまった。
dialogues.en: As Nemu drags me away, I keep looking back.
dialogues.text: As Nemu drags me away, I keep looking back.

dialogues.jp: 主の帰りを待つ家を眺めた。
dialogues.en: I look at the house that's waiting for its owner.
dialogues.text: I look at the house that's waiting for its owner.

dialogues.jp:
まだ、俺達の笑い声が｛こだま／木霊｝して聞こえてくるよ
うな気がするのだ。
dialogues.en: I feel like I can hear the echoes of our childhood laughter.
dialogues.text: I feel like I can hear the echoes of our childhood laughter.

dialogues.jp: それは夢――さくらがいなくなった後の夢。
dialogues.en: That was a dream after Sakura had gone.
dialogues.text: That was a dream after Sakura had gone.

dialogues.jp:
空家になってしまった隣家を見上げながら、さ
くらや死んでしまったばあちゃんのことを思う。
dialogues.en:
I looked up at the empty house next door, and thought of
Sakura and my dead grandma.
dialogues.text:
I looked up at the empty house next door, and thought of
Sakura and my dead grandma.

dialogues.jp:
いなくなる人もいるけれど、新しく会う人もい
る――私が一緒にいるよと笑う音夢に頷きなが
ら、俺は学校への道を歩みだした。
dialogues.en:
Some people were leaving, but some people were coming into
my life as well. I walked towards the new school, giving
Nemu a nod when she said she would stay with me.
dialogues.text:
Some people were leaving, but some people were coming into
my life as well. I walked towards the new school, giving
Nemu a nod when she said she would stay with me.
